summary_en: ¥9,000/share tender offer by Ursa 4 K.K. (special purpose vehicle) for J.S.B. common stock and 2nd warrant instruments. Minimum acceptance 14,109,500 shares (66.4% ownership post-tender). Warrant: ¥1,735,000 per unit. Tender period 30 business days (June 15 – July 27, 2026). Board recommends. Intent: complete subsidiary acquisition and delisting.
title_en: Notice of Board Opinion on Public Tender Offer for Shares and Warrants by Ursa 4 K.K.
translation_en_brief: On 12 June 2026, J.S.B. Co., Ltd. (ticker 3480, TSE Prime) announced that its board has expressed support for and recommended shareholder and warrant-holder participation in a public tender offer launched by Ursa 4 K.K., a special purpose vehicle established 25 May 2026 (100% owned by Ursa 3 K.K.) with registered office in Tokyo and representative Stephen G. Glen. The tender offer targets J.S.B. common stock at ¥9,000 per share and series-2 warrant instruments at ¥1,735,000 per unit. The offer runs 30 business days from 15 June to 27 July 2026. The minimum acceptance threshold is 14,109,500 shares (calculated as two-thirds of 21,173,876 total voting units less director/employee restricted shares, then multiplied by 100-share unit size), which would result in Ursa 4 holding 66.4% post-tender. The board's support is conditioned on the offeror's stated intent to complete an acquisition resulting in J.S.B. becoming a wholly owned subsidiary and subsequent delisting from the TSE Prime market. No upper limit on share purchases is disclosed. No prior capital, personnel, or transaction relationships exist between J.S.B. and Ursa 4.
